message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) resulted in roughly **48,000 total casualties**:

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| Allied (British, Dutch‑Hessian, Prussian, etc.) | ~23,000 |
| French | ~25,000 |

So, in total, about **48,000 soldiers** were killed, wounded, or taken prisoner/missing in that decisive engagement.
